text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I am Kawakami Princess! A slightly 
tomboyish horse girl taking on the Twinkle 
Series at Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My goal is to become a brave, gallant, and 
elegant "princess," just like the 
protagonist of the anime "Bakusou Mouki ☆ 
Princess Fighter"!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If I'm the princess, that makes you the 
"Legendary Trainer" from Prifight, 
Trainer! Let's make our dreams come true 
together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the admired King Halo-san watching 
over me, the battle to become a princess 
begins...! Whatever obstacle stands in my 
way, I'll smash it with a Princess☆Kick!
